core.big_idea: God promised forgiveness and a renewed relationship with His people.

passages.reading_note: Read in immediate context; use age-appropriate portions without changing the claim.

claims.statement: Jeremiah contrasts the promised new covenant with the covenant Israel broke after the Exodus.
The promise includes God’s instruction written within, renewed relationship, knowledge of God, and forgiveness.
Taken together, these passages support the lesson’s big idea: God promised forgiveness and a renewed relationship with His people.
